$comment: Labelled corpus for scope-guard threshold calibration.
PROVENANCE: authored in-repo. Not collected from production traffic and not
dual-annotated. It is a larger and more varied replacement for the 16 messages
that were hardcoded in tools/calibrate_scope_threshold.py, and it is split into
a calibration half and a held-out half so that a generalisation estimate can be
reported at all -- the previous script could only report its own fitting score.
This is NOT the T2 set. T2 requires human annotators and a kappa gate (see
configs/c1_rules.json); these are one author's labels, so the held-out numbers
are an optimistic estimate and must be quoted as such.
The split is by CONTRACT, not by message. Holding out messages from a contract
the threshold was fitted on would leak that contract's similarity scale into
the test set and overstate generalisation.
